ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

4. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 4
   C. 9
   D. 12

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 40

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 7

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

9. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

10. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

11. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. B — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
